lines.en: label chapthree4:
scene summerclass1
: What the heck is this?! Was our class always this adorable?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么情况?!我们班一直都这么可爱吗?!

lines.en: : The new uniforms came in this morning. Well...all except one.
lines.zh: : 新校服是今天早上送到的。嗯……只除了一件。

lines.en: scene summerclass2
: APPARENTLY, I’m a little {i}too old{/i} to wear a school uniform! And that it {i}isn’t appropriate{/i} for working adults to wear them! Which totally isn’t insulting at all!
lines.zh: : 据说,我这个年纪穿校服「稍微」有点{i}太大{/i}了!还说上班的成年人穿校服{i}不合适{/i}!这可真是一点都不伤人啊!

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like I’ve wanted to go to school with uniforms for my entire life or anything. And it’s not like you guys are only a little younger than me {i}or anything!{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说,我又不是从小就一直想穿着校服上学什么的。你们也不过比我小一点点{i}而已{/i}嘛!

lines.en: scene summerclass3
: AND IT’S NOT LIKE I ACTUALLY CARE OR ANYTHING!
lines.zh: : 而且我才没有真的在意呢!

lines.en: : You doing okay over there?
lines.zh: : 你那边还好吗?

lines.en: scene summerclass4
: Just peachy, Senpai. Just peachy.
lines.zh: : 好得很,Senpai。好得很。

lines.en: Just as Imani said, it looks like all of the girls have changed into their new uniforms and that we no longer have roughly half the class decked out in one that I never thought was flattering to begin with.
lines.zh: 正如 Imani 所说,看起来所有女孩都换上了新校服,我们也不再有大约半个班穿着那套我从一开始就不觉得好看的旧制服了。

lines.en: Also, it looks like all of them are {i}still here{/i} with the exception of the one girl who’s never here to begin with.
lines.zh: 而且看起来她们全都{i}还在{/i}——除了那个本来就不怎么出现的女孩。

lines.en: But hey, if Yumi is gone, at least my days will be easier and filled with less profanity.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来,如果 Yumi 不在,至少我的日子会好过些,脏话也会少些。

lines.en: : Uhh...did something happen to Miku? She looks unusually...{i}not loud{/i} today.
lines.zh: : 呃……Miku 是出了什么事吗?她今天看起来格外……{i}不吵{/i}。

lines.en: scene summerclass5
: Ahh...yeah.
: The school decided to do away with all of the intramural sports teams since none of them had anybody to play against and were running low on members anyway.
lines.zh: : 学校决定取消所有校内运动队,因为反正没有对手可打,而且队员也一直不够。

lines.en: : The soccer team just happened to be among the casualties. She’s looked pretty down ever since I came in this morning.
lines.zh: : 足球队刚好就在被砍掉的名单里。从我今早进来开始,她看上去就一直很消沉。

lines.en: scene summerclass6
: Thankfully, she’s got her friends with her to cheer her up and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 还好她身边有朋友能哄哄她什么的。

lines.en: : Besides, we’ve got plenty of other sports clubs still going strong! Or...ones that are on the cusp of going strong but...haven’t actually {i}started{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我们还有一大堆其他体育社团活得好好的!或者……那些眼看就要好起来、不过……还没真正{i}开张{/i}的。

lines.en: : What I’m trying to say is that there’s no shortage of excuses for her to be active. But yeah, kinda sucks when something you love gets taken away.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是,她想活动活动,借口多得是。不过话说回来,喜欢的东西被夺走,确实挺难受的。

lines.en: : But anyway! I guess I’m gonna do the thing now since we’re already like two hours behind thanks to all of the fluids you had to clean off of each other.
lines.zh: : 总之!我猜我该办正事了,毕竟托你们互相清洗体液的福,我们已经落后了差不多两小时。

lines.en: : What? Ew. Why would you even say something like that? Aren’t you supposed to be the good teacher?
lines.zh: : 什么?恶。你干嘛非要说这种话?你不是应该当好老师吗?

lines.en: : No way! I’m the young and quirky one who you’re all supposed to look up to because I am both an intellectual {i}and{/i} super cool.
lines.zh: : 才不要!我是那个年轻又古怪、你们都该仰望的人,因为我既是个知识分子,{i}又{/i}超级酷。

lines.en: : Also, I think I see a little love juice stuck in your hair, so I’m just gonna-
lines.zh: : 还有,我觉得你头发上粘了一点点爱液,所以我打算——

lines.en: : Touch me and I will kill you.
lines.zh: : 你敢碰我,我就杀了你。

lines.en: : Jeeeez. {i}Somebody{/i} needs a post-coitus cigarette.
lines.zh: : 天哪。{i}有人{/i}需要来根事后烟了。

lines.en: : Imani, do the announcement thing.
lines.zh: : Imani,去干宣布那件事吧。

lines.en: : Fine, fine! Just let me look at my notes one more time.
lines.zh: : 行行行!让我再看一眼笔记。

lines.en: scene summerclass7
: Where exactly did we get her again?
lines.zh: : 我们到底是从哪儿把她弄来的?

lines.en: : Ghana.
lines.zh: : 加纳。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean {i}literally{/i}. I mean how is a borderline predator as a teacher any better than an actual predator?
lines.zh: : 我不是问{i}字面上的{/i}意思。我是说,一个「准捕食者」当老师,又比真正的捕食者好在哪儿?

lines.en: : Technically, she’s a {i}student{/i} teacher.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,她是{i}实习{/i}老师。

lines.en: : Yeah. Sensei is teaching her how to become a full predator and it falls on you and me to serve as examples to help her learn.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Sensei 正在教她怎么变成完全的捕食者,而给你和我当示范、帮她学习的重任就落在我们身上了。

lines.en: scene summerclass8
: Please tell me this isn’t just how you’re going to be now.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你以后不会一直是这个样子。

lines.en: : But Maya, all that’s really changed about me is that I know we’re rivals now. And I think that’s something we can bond over.
lines.zh: : 可 Maya,我真正变了的地方只有一点——我现在知道我们是情敌了。而我觉得这一点反而能让我们更亲近。

lines.en: : We are rivals over nothing and anything you {i}thought{/i} you heard was simply apocalypse-induced delirium.
lines.zh: : 我们根本算不上情敌,你{i}以为{/i}自己听到的那些,纯粹是末日引发的谵妄。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just have to be the {i}only{/i} test subject for Imani’s predatorial lessons.
lines.zh: : 没关系。那我就{i}独自{/i}充当 Imani 捕食者课程的小白鼠好了。

lines.en: : I sure hope my body can handle it.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我的身体扛得住。

lines.en: scene summerclass9
: Oh, I’m sure it can.
lines.zh: : 哦,我敢肯定它扛得住。

lines.en: scene summerclass10
: Hey! What’s the big deal?! You three show up an hour late in casual clothes and don’t even ask me if I want to join in?!
lines.zh: : 喂!这到底是怎么回事?!你们三个迟到一个小时,还穿着便服,居然都不问我一句要不要一起?!

lines.en: : I swear, if you guys are having some special sort of Sensei Love Squad meeting without the {i}president{/i} of the Sensei Love Squad, I will end all three of you!
lines.zh: : 我发誓,如果你们背着 Sensei 亲卫队的{i}队长{/i}开什么 Sensei 亲卫队特别会议,我就把你们三个全干掉!

lines.en: : Even me?
lines.zh: : 连我也算?

lines.en: scene summerclass11
: Mhm! Ayane left her notes at her house the other night and I read her plans for the next science fair about how to reanimate dead bodies.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼!前几天晚上 Ayane 把笔记落在我家了,我还读了她为下一届科学展写的计划——关于怎么让死人复活的。

lines.en: : Hey! Stop going through my things! Those plans were for Sana and me only!
lines.zh: : 喂!别翻我的东西!那份计划只给 Sana 和我看过!

lines.en: scene summerclass12
: Seriously, though. What’s going on here? Why are you guys dressed like that? And why are you showing up so late?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。这是怎么回事?你们为什么穿成这样?为什么来得这么晚?

lines.en: : It was weird enough that you made me walk to school by myself, but now I have to figure out why you’re keeping secrets from me and-
lines.zh: : 你让我一个人走路上学就已经够奇怪了,现在我还得搞清楚你们为什么要瞒着我,而且——

lines.en: scene summerclass13
: Wait!
lines.zh: : 等等!

lines.en: : You three are planning a surprise party for me, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你们三个是在为我策划惊喜派对,对吧?!

lines.en: : Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜。

lines.en: scene summerclass14
: Is it...really August already? I feel like our Christmas party wasn’t even that long ago.
lines.zh: : 已经……真的到八月了吗?我总觉得我们的圣诞派对好像没过去多久。

lines.en: : Aww! You guys! You didn’t have to go and do something like that for me. You know I’m happy just being with you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀!你们这些人!你们根本不必为我做这种事。你们知道的,只要和你们在一起我就很开心。

lines.en: scene summerclass15
: But...if you {i}are{/i} going to throw a party for me, I’m not {i}opposed.{/i} I’d just like some say in the decorations. Oh, and I’ll make the cake.
lines.zh: : 不过……如果你们{i}真要{/i}为我办派对,我也不{i}反对{/i}。我只是想对装饰有点发言权。哦,还有,蛋糕我来烤。

lines.en: : You’re going to make the cake for your own surprise party?
lines.zh: : 你要为自己的惊喜派对烤蛋糕?

lines.en: : Well, yeah. I don’t trust anyone else and I assume Sensei is going to eat it, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯,对啊。别人我都不放心,而且我猜 Sensei 会吃,所以……

lines.en: : Okay, well...I’m going to go sit down and...try and sort out my thoughts for the...uhh...{i}surprise party.{/i} But the three of you are free to continue standing around and...being weird.
lines.zh: : 好吧,那……我去坐下,然后……试着整理一下我对这场……呃……{i}惊喜派对{/i}的思绪。不过你们三个可以继续站在这儿……继续古怪下去。

lines.en: scene summerclass16
: Wait, before you sit down, are we still going to karaoke with Uta after class? Because Io apparently bailed on her and it makes me feel weird how she’s always going there to sing all by herself.
lines.zh: : 等等,你坐下之前,我们下课后还跟 Uta 去唱卡拉OK吧?因为 Io 好像放她鸽子了,而她总是一个人去那儿唱,总让我觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh...{i}yes?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃……{i}要吧?{/i}……

lines.en: : Why do you sound so unsure? Do you hate Uta now? Or...wait! Do you hate {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你为什么听起来这么不确定?你现在讨厌 Uta 了?还是……等等!你讨厌{i}我{/i}了?

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Ami, this is probably going to sound like a weird question, but...
lines.zh: : Ami,这个问题听起来大概会很怪,不过……

lines.en: : Does Despacito still exist in this timeline?
lines.zh: : 这条时间线里 Despacito 还在吗?

lines.en: scene summerclass17
: Seriously? That is what you’re concerned about?
lines.zh: : 说真的?你关心的就是这个?

lines.en: : I need to know.
lines.zh: : 我必须知道。

lines.en: : Why...
lines.zh: : 为什么……

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t Despacito exist anymore?
lines.zh: : Despacito 为什么会不存在了?

lines.en: scene summerclass18
: Thank you, Ami. That is all I needed to hear.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Ami。我想知道的就是这个。

lines.en: scene summerclass19
: Attention, girls who are only slightly younger than I am and still allowed to wear school uniforms without being judged!
lines.zh: : 各位只比我小一点点、还被允许穿校服而不被人指指点点的姑娘们,请注意!

lines.en: : Miss Imai, I hardly think that’s an appropriate way to start this announcement.
lines.zh: : Imai 老师,我觉得这可不太适合作为这场宣布的开场白。

lines.en: scene summerclass20
: Hey! Fuck you!
lines.zh: : 嘿!去你的!

lines.en: : Wha-
: God I love her so much.
lines.zh: : 天哪我真是太爱她了。

lines.en: scene summerclass19
: Anyway! What I was about to say is that the deadline for the Great Migration, also known as the Wonky Club Hop and the After School Switcharoo is tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 总之!我刚才想说的是,「大迁徙」——也就是「歪歪扭扭社团大跳槽」和「放学后大换血」——的截止日期就是明天!

lines.en: : This means that everybody-
lines.zh: : 这意味着每个人——

lines.en: scene summerclass21
: And I mean {i}everybody!{/i} I’m looking at you, Sana!
lines.zh: : 我说的每个人是{i}每一个人{/i}!我正看着你呢,Sana!

lines.en: : W-What?! What did I do?!
lines.zh: : 什……什么?!我做什么了?!

lines.en: : {i}Everybody{/i} has to choose a club to join! No more of that “Going Home Club” BS.
lines.zh: : {i}每个人{/i}都必须选一个社团加入!别再搞那套「回家社」的鬼话了。

lines.en: : Do I make myself clear, Sana?!
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗,Sana?!

lines.en: : Umm...uhh!
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯嗯!

lines.en: scene summerclass22
: Love the new get-up, by the way. You’re cute as hell, girl.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句,我很喜欢你这身新行头。你可爱得要命,丫头。

lines.en: : I...umm...thank you?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……谢谢?

lines.en: : Imani! What do you think of my new uniform? How do I look?
lines.zh: : Imani!你觉得我的新校服怎么样?我看起来如何?

lines.en: scene summerclass23
: Like a slut pretending to not be a slut!
lines.zh: : 像个装作不是骚货的骚货!

lines.en: : Ah-
: Do you still love her now, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你现在还爱她吗,Kirin?

lines.en: : I think I love her even more...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我更爱她了……

lines.en: scene summerclass24
: Anyway! If anybody has any questions or needs a full list of what clubs there are to choose from, come talk to me!
lines.zh: : 总之!如果有谁有问题,或者需要一份可供选择的社团完整清单,来找我谈!

lines.en: : Until then, class dismissed! Just...not really. Since there are still, like...five hours left of the school day.
lines.zh: : 在那之前,下课!不过……其实没下课。毕竟今天还剩,嗯……五个小时。

lines.en: : Guhhhhhhhhhh~
lines.zh: : 呜啊啊啊啊啊啊啊~

lines.en: : Kirin, can you please keep your hormones in check for five minutes and focus on the task at hand?
lines.zh: : Kirin,你能不能把荷尔蒙收一收,专注在眼前的事情上五分钟?

lines.en: scene summerclass25
: Right! Yeah! Sorry!
lines.zh: : 对!好的!抱歉!

lines.en: : Miku, you’re going to be {i}fine{/i} without the soccer team. You know that, right? There are tons of other clubs you’d be great at.
lines.zh: : Miku,没有足球队你也会{i}没事{/i}的。你知道的,对吧?还有很多别的社团你都能做得很好。

lines.en: : And, even on the off chance you wind up sucking at them for some reason, I’m sure there’s some sort of...recreational soccer league you can join around here, right?
lines.zh: : 而且,就算万一你因为什么原因玩得很烂,我相信这附近总有某种……业余足球联赛可以加入,对吧?

lines.en: : It ain’t the same, Kirin. The team is...
lines.zh: : 那不一样,Kirin。这支队伍是……

lines.en: : The team is...
lines.zh: : 这支队伍是……

lines.en: scene summerclass26
: They’re the only family I’ve got!
lines.zh: : 他们是我唯一的家人!

lines.en: : Seein’ them every weekend’s what keeps me goin’! And now I can’t even do that because the friggin’ school thinks it’s pointless if we ain’t got anybody to play against?!
lines.zh: : 每个周末能见到他们,才是我撑下去的动力!可现在连这个都做不到了,就因为这破学校觉得没有对手可打就没意义?!

lines.en: : That ain’t what it’s about! That ain’t ever been what’s it about!
lines.zh: : 这事根本不是那么回事!从来就不是那么回事!

lines.en: : They’re not gone, Miku...I’m still here. {i}Karin’s{/i} still here. We’re just...going our separate ways now.
lines.zh: : 他们没有消失,Miku……我还在。{i}Karin{/i} 也还在。我们只是……要各走各的路了。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna go separate ways...I wanna stay together with everybody. I ain’t ready to leave yet!
lines.zh: : 我不想各走各的路……我想和大家待在一起。我还没准备好离开!

lines.en: scene summerclass27

: Well...what if you come join the archery club? I know it’s not really as {i}active{/i} as you’d probably like, but...I mean, {i}I{/i} was never great at soccer anyway. And that’s where I plan on going, so at least you’d have me.
lines.zh: : 那个……你要不要来弓道部?我知道它可能没你希望的那么{i}有运动量{/i},不过……我的意思是,{i}我{/i}本来踢足球也不怎么样。而我打算去那儿,所以至少你还有我。

lines.en: : There’s always the swim club as well, Miku. And it’s got an Olympic size pool, so you’d be able to get as much energy out as you want.
lines.zh: : 还有游泳部可以选,Miku。而且那里有个奥运会规格的泳池,你想消耗多少精力都行。

lines.en: scene summerclass28
: I’m sorry you guys feel like you’ve gotta cheer me up. I’ve known about this for weeks, so the fact that I’m cryin’ about it now must seem pretty stupid, huh?
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你们觉得非得哄我。我几个星期前就知道了,所以我现在还哭,一定显得很蠢吧?

lines.en: : Not at all. Soccer’s always been a huge part of your life.
lines.zh: : 一点也不。足球一直是你生命里很大的一部分。

lines.en: : Yeah! But that doesn’t mean there aren’t other parts that won’t be enjoyable!
lines.zh: : 对啊!但这不代表别的部分就不会让人开心!

lines.en: : Like hey, you might {i}love{/i} archery! You won’t know until you try!
lines.zh: : 比如说,你也许会{i}喜欢{/i}上弓道!不试试怎么知道!

lines.en: scene summerclass29
: I do think the swim club would make more sense, though. Especially for someone like Miku who’s more accustomed to {i}active{/i} sports.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实觉得游泳部更合理一些。尤其是对 Miku 这种更习惯{i}剧烈{/i}运动的人来说。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s not like archery {i}isn’t{/i} active. Have you ever tried using a longbow? That shit’s exhausting, prez.
lines.zh: : 是,可弓道也{i}不是{/i}不动啊。你试过长弓吗?那玩意儿累死人,部长。

lines.en: : I didn’t say it wasn’t. But I do think that maybe we should be taking Miku’s best interests into consideration and weighing which options would most closely correlate to what she’s used to.
lines.zh: : 我没说它不累。但我确实觉得,也许我们该把 Miku 的最大利益考虑进去,衡量一下哪个选项最接近她习惯的东西。

lines.en: scene summerclass30
: I {i}did{/i} that, Makoto. I’m sure I don’t have to remind you of how long Miku and I have been on a team together, do I?
lines.zh: : 我{i}已经考虑过了{/i},Makoto。我想不用我提醒你,Miku 和我在同一支队伍里待了多久吧?

lines.en: : Do you actually think that compares to how long {i}I’ve{/i} been with Miku for? Because-
lines.zh: : 你真觉得那比得上{i}我{/i}跟 Miku 待在一起的时间吗?因为——

lines.en: : If you guys are just gonna fight over me, go back to yer own desks. I’ll join whichever club I feel like joinin’.
lines.zh: : 要是你们俩只是为了抢我,那就回自己座位去。我爱加入哪个社团就加入哪个。

lines.en: : But right now, I just...kinda wanna be left alone.
lines.zh: : 不过现在,我只……有点想一个人待着。

lines.en: : Great, {i}now{/i} look what you’ve done, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 好啊,瞧你干的好事,Makoto。

lines.en: : Me? You can’t be serious. I’m the one who was trying to {i}stop{/i} you just now.
lines.zh: : 我?你开玩笑吧。刚才想{i}拦住{/i}你的人明明是我。

lines.en: scene summerclass31
: Hah...
: Or just keep fightin’...
lines.zh: : 或者你们继续吵也行……

lines.en: : That’s fine too...
lines.zh: : 那样也挺好……

lines.en: scene black
scene summerclass32
: Dude! I can’t believe I’m actually, like...stoked for a school-related thing. But the more I think about it, the more into it I’m getting.
lines.zh: : 老兄!我真不敢相信我居然会……对一件跟学校有关的事这么兴奋。但越想,我就越来劲。

lines.en: : I’m stoked {i}for{/i} you, Otoha! Joining the light music club means you’ll get to play pretty much whenever you want!
lines.zh: : 我{i}替{/i}你兴奋,Otoha!加入轻音部意味着你基本想弹就能弹!

lines.en: : Which means that I will be able to {i}hear{/i} you play whenever {i}I{/i} want! Which means that both of our schedules have gotten exponentially better out of virtually nowhere!
lines.zh: : 也就是说,{i}我{/i}想听你弹就能{i}听{/i}!也就是说,我们俩的日程几乎是凭空变好了一大截!

lines.en: scene summerclass33
: Yeah. And between this and your hot new haircut, it seems like my days have been getting a lot better in a {i}bunch{/i} of ways, lately.
lines.zh: : 是啊。加上你这个帅气的新发型,感觉最近我的日子在{i}很多{/i}方面都变好了不少。

lines.en: : Oh, this? I mean...this is just hair. Hair that...grows out of my head. Which is now shorter. Which you apparently like.
lines.zh: : 哦,这个?我是说……这只是头发而已。从……我脑袋上长出来的头发。现在变短了。而你显然很喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s good to see you two are still doing well.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你们两个感情还是这么好。

lines.en: : Is...Is Rin...broken?...
lines.zh: : Rin……是不是……坏掉了?……

lines.en: : Yeah...things were a little rocky for a bit after the Christmas party, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……圣诞派对之后有一阵子不太顺利,不过——

lines.en: scene summerclass34
: OTOHA OKAKURA!
lines.zh: : OTOHA OKAKURA!

lines.en: : Um...N...Noriko...Nakayama?
lines.zh: : 呃……N……Noriko……Nakayama?

lines.en: : It’s Nakayarakawayama now. I changed my name.
lines.zh: : 现在叫 Nakayarakawayama 了。我改了名字。

lines.en: : Can you change it back?
lines.zh: : 你能改回来吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay then. You do you.
lines.zh: : 哦。那好吧。你开心就好。

lines.en: : You’re joining, right? The light music club?
lines.zh: : 你会加入的吧?轻音部?

lines.en: scene summerclass35
: Oh man. Does this mean what I think it means?
lines.zh: : 哦天。这意味着我想的那件事吗?

lines.en: : Should we start booking our reunion tour now? Or later?
lines.zh: : 我们现在就该开始预约重聚巡演吗?还是晚点再说?

lines.en: scene summerclass36
: THE BAND IS GETTING BACK TOGETHER, BITCHES!
lines.zh: : 乐队要重组啦,贱人们!

lines.en: : You two were...in a band together?...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……以前组过乐队?……

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. It’s not like we ever really played any shows or anything. My parents were always weird about that.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。其实我们从没真正演出过什么的。我父母对那种事一向很奇怪。

lines.en: : But it’ll be a hell of a lot easier to hide now that I don’t live at home anymore. Plus, Noriko’s like, a ridiculous fucking bassist.
lines.zh: : 不过现在我不住家里了,要瞒着就容易多了。再说,Noriko 那贝斯弹得,简直他妈离谱。

lines.en: scene summerclass37
: What can I say? I’m an expert when it comes to fingering.
lines.zh: : 能说什么呢?在「拨弄」这门手艺上,我是专家。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things like that around my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 别在我女朋友面前说这种话。

lines.en: scene summerclass38
: Speaking of which! You’re gonna join too, right?! Having another guitarist would mean that all we’re missing is a drummer and, like...{i}maybe{/i} someone on keys if we want to go full K-On.
lines.zh: : 说到这个!你也要加入的吧?!再多一个吉他手,我们就只差一个鼓手,还有……如果我们想搞成完整版 K-On,{i}大概{/i}还差个键盘手。

lines.en: : Me? Uhh...
: Y...Yeah! Totally! I’d love to join you guys if Otoha is okay with it!
lines.zh: : 当……当然!完全愿意!只要 Otoha 没意见,我很想跟你们一起!

lines.en: : Are you kidding? Why wouldn’t I be okay with that? I’d love to be in the same club as you.
lines.zh: : 你开什么玩笑?我怎么会没意见?能跟你同一个社团我开心都来不及。

lines.en: scene summerclass39
: Wait, Rin...what about the manga club?
lines.zh: : 等等,Rin……那漫画部怎么办?

lines.en: : ...Fuck.
: Does this mean you’re planning on leaving?
lines.zh: : 这是说你打算离开吗?

lines.en: : Well...
: I’m not going to get offended if you want to stay in manga club, Rin. I just think it would be cool to be in the same club together.
lines.zh: : 如果你想留在漫画部,我不会生气的,Rin。我只是觉得能跟你同一个社团会很酷。

lines.en: scene summerclass40
: No, I...I really want to join the light music club with you guys! I’ve always wanted to be in something like that and...and I want to spend more time with you!
lines.zh: : 不,我……我真的很想跟你们一起进轻音部!我一直都想参加那种社团,而且……而且我想多跟你待在一起!

lines.en: : It’s just...I don’t...really know what to do.
lines.zh: : 只是……我……不太知道该怎么办。

lines.en: scene summerclass41
: Well...whatever you {i}do{/i} decide to do...know that I won’t take it personally.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管你最后怎么{i}决定{/i}……我都不会往心里去。

lines.en: : But if you {i}are{/i} planning on leaving the manga club...you should at least talk to Molly about it.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你{i}真打算{/i}退出漫画部……至少该跟 Molly 谈一谈。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be right to just...abandon her without saying anything.
lines.zh: : 就这么一声不吭地把她丢下,总归说不过去。

lines.en: : Yeah...I know...just...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道……只是……

lines.en: scene summerclass42
: Ugh...this would be so much easier if we were allowed to be in two clubs at once.
lines.zh: : 唉……要是允许同时参加两个社团,这事就简单多了。

lines.en: : What about you, Nodoka? You’ve been awfully silent over there.
lines.zh: : 你呢,Nodoka?你在那边安静得有点过分了。

lines.en: : Any idea what club you’re joining yet?
lines.zh: : 想好要加入哪个社团了吗?

lines.en: scene summerclass43
: Heh heh heh...
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵……

lines.en: : As if there was ever a choice to begin with...
lines.zh: : 好像从一开始就有得选似的……

lines.en: scene summerclass44
: Skintight...spandex...school swimsuits...
lines.zh: : 紧身……氨纶……学校泳衣……

lines.en: : Changing and showering together...
lines.zh: : 一起换衣服、一起洗澡……

lines.en: : Touching each other’s bodies...
lines.zh: : 触碰彼此的身体……

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s part of the-
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那应该不是——

lines.en: : The medley of assorted shampoos blending together into the single purest, most mouth-watering aroma a person could ask for...
lines.zh: : 各种洗发水的气味混在一起,调和出一个人所乞求的、最纯粹、最让人垂涎的芬芳……

lines.en: scene summerclass43
: Not to mention the probability of wardrobe malfunctions is exponentially higher in the swim club than any other club this school has to offer...
lines.zh: : 更不用说,游泳部发生走光的概率,比这所学校其他任何社团都要高得多得多……

lines.en: : Hearing all of that, do you truly think there could be any other place for me?
lines.zh: : 听了这些,你真觉得我还能去别的地方吗?

lines.en: : Nope. That’s pretty much you, alright.
lines.zh: : 不能。这很符合你的风格,没错。

lines.en: : Well...at least you’re honest.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少你还算诚实。

lines.en: : Is Nodoka always this...um...
lines.zh: : Nodoka 一直都这么……呃……

lines.en: : Whatever you’re going to ask, the answer is yes.
lines.zh: : 不管你想问什么,答案都是「是」。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think Nodoka might like girls even more than you do, Rin.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得,Nodoka 说不定比你还喜欢女孩子,Rin。

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin?

lines.en: : I think...um...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……呃……

lines.en: : Maybe I want to...join the swim club as well...
lines.zh: : 也许我也想……加入游泳部……
